rules.name: funnel-example
rules.sql: SELECT deal_id FROM legacy_schema.deals WHERE business_unit = :businessUnit
SELECT deal_id FROM opera.deals WHERE business_unit = :businessUnit
SELECT deal_id FROM legacy_schema.deals WHERE business_unit = :businessUnit AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT deal_id FROM opera.deals WHERE business_unit = :businessUnit AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT deal_id FROM legacy_schema.deals WHERE business_unit = :businessUnit AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_eligible = 1
SELECT deal_id FROM opera.deals WHERE business_unit = :businessUnit AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_eligible = 1

expect.reason: the two sides should keep the same deals at every stage
